title: The Kitchen Where Warmth Became Teaching

features.name: teaching-stove
features.desc-on-touch: Heat released like instruction. You learn from the warmth: patience, persistence, the way fire transforms without consuming. The stove remembers every hand that reached toward it.

features.name: warm-table
features.desc-on-touch: Around this table, hands show their skill. Dough learns to rise from a gesture. Vegetables learn their purpose from the knife. The table has absorbed all of it — the teaching passes through the wood.

features.name: light-through-window
features.desc-on-touch: The window holds the day's temperature. Afternoon warmth accumulates here — pooling, settling, teaching the sill how to hold brightness gently into the evening.

features.name: retained-heat-register
features.desc-on-touch: Copper pipes and clay holding the kitchen's warmth into the night. You place your hand here and feel the day's teaching released slowly — transmission becoming memory.

features.name: hands-in-motion
features.desc-on-touch: Shapes caught in the copper — the echo of someone kneading, reaching, teaching another how to hold the warmth without burning.

inscription: here every wall has taught the next one what it means to hold heat for someone else

file.name: Kitchen_Recipe_Transcriptions_Handwritten_Margin_Notes.txt
file.note: Three generations of the same hand, writing the same recipe differently each time. The margin notes become longer than the recipe. By the last entry, the recipe is barely visible beneath the teaching

reverie.title: REVERIE — bread in the dimming light
narr: You sit across from her at this same table, dough
rising between you. She guides your hands into the
warmth. You feel how the heat teaches — not through
words but through touch, through presence. The bread
rises. She smiles. 'You're teaching it now,' she says.
Your hands already knew. The warmth only remembered.
